doc_compare.description: Compare the text of two open documents: other is the older version, doc the newer. Returns counts and each change (replaced, inserted, deleted) with the old and new text, pages (1-based) and rectangles (points, origin bottom-left).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

limit.description: List at most this many changes (default 500).

visual.description: Also compare how pages look (page n with page n): regions that differ visually.
